text: {"lessons":["A falling account value is painful, but avoiding a sale just to avoid admitting a mistake can let risk drift; I should reassess each holding on its merits.","Taking a gain may feel satisfying, but my purchase price and unrealized gain or loss are not reliable reasons by themselves to sell or hold.","Past price moves have not given me a dependable forecast, so I should focus on diversification and my intended risk level rather than reacting to recent performance."]}
